SELECT evaluator_jobs.id, evaluator_revisions.default_threshold AS threshold, evaluator_profiles.evaluator_type, count(dataset_samples.id) AS total, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(evaluation_items.status = ? AND score_results.id IS NOT NULL AND CASE WHEN (evaluator_profiles.evaluator_type = ?) THEN CASE WHEN (score_results.score BETWEEN ? AND ?) THEN ? ELSE score_results.score END ELSE score_results.score END BETWEEN ? AND CASE WHEN (evaluator_profiles.evaluator_type = ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END, ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END) AS successful, avg(CASE WHEN coalesce(evaluation_items.status = ? AND score_results.id IS NOT NULL AND CASE WHEN (evaluator_profiles.evaluator_type = ?) THEN CASE WHEN (score_results.score BETWEEN ? AND ?) THEN ? ELSE score_results.score END ELSE score_results.score END BETWEEN ? AND CASE WHEN (evaluator_profiles.evaluator_type = ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END, ?) THEN score_results.score END) AS micro_mean, sum(CASE WHEN (coalesce(evaluation_items.status = ? AND score_results.id IS NOT NULL AND CASE WHEN (evaluator_profiles.evaluator_type = ?) THEN CASE WHEN (score_results.score BETWEEN ? AND ?) THEN ? ELSE score_results.score END ELSE score_results.score END BETWEEN ? AND CASE WHEN (evaluator_profiles.evaluator_type = ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END, ?) = 1 AND CASE WHEN (evaluator_profiles.evaluator_type = ?) THEN CASE WHEN (score_results.score BETWEEN ? AND ?) THEN ? ELSE score_results.score END ELSE score_results.score END >= evaluator_revisions.default_threshold) THEN ? ELSE ? END) AS passed 
FROM evaluator_jobs JOIN evaluator_revisions ON evaluator_revisions.id = evaluator_jobs.evaluator_revision_id JOIN evaluator_profiles ON evaluator_profiles.id = evaluator_revisions.profile_id JOIN dataset_jobs ON dataset_jobs.id = evaluator_jobs.dataset_job_id JOIN submission_datasets ON submission_datasets.id = dataset_jobs.submission_dataset_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dataset_samples ON dataset_samples.dataset_version_id = submission_datasets.dataset_version_id LEFT OUTER JOIN predictions ON predictions.submission_dataset_id = submission_datasets.id AND predictions.sample_id = dataset_samples.sample_id LEFT OUTER JOIN evaluation_items ON evaluation_items.prediction_id = predictions.id AND evaluation_items.evaluator_job_id = evaluator_jobs.id LEFT OUTER JOIN score_results ON score_results.id = evaluation_items.score_result_id 
WHERE evaluator_jobs.id IN (?) GROUP BY evaluator_jobs.id, evaluator_revisions.default_threshold, evaluator_profiles.evaluator_type

FROM evaluator_jobs JOIN evaluator_revisions ON evaluator_revisions.id = evaluator_jobs.evaluator_revision_id JOIN evaluator_profiles ON evaluator_profiles.id = evaluator_revisions.profile_id JOIN dataset_jobs ON dataset_jobs.id = evaluator_jobs.dataset_job_id JOIN submission_datasets ON submission_datasets.id = dataset_jobs.submission_dataset_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dataset_samples ON dataset_samples.dataset_version_id = submission_datasets.dataset_version_id LEFT OUTER JOIN predictions ON predictions.submission_dataset_id = submission_datasets.id AND predictions.sample_id = dataset_samples.sample_id LEFT OUTER JOIN evaluation_items ON evaluation_items.prediction_id = predictions.id AND evaluation_items.evaluator_job_id = evaluator_jobs.id LEFT OUTER JOIN score_results ON score_results.id = evaluation_items.score_result_id
